summary: Banc of America Merrill Lynch Commercial Mortgage Inc., as depositor for BANK 2017-BNK9, filed an 8-K reporting that effective October 2, 2026, Argentic Services Company LP was removed as special servicer and Torchlight Loan Services, LLC was appointed successor special servicer for the Colorado Center Mortgage Loan, representing about 5.7% of the asset pool at cut-off, under the BXP Trust 2017-CC TSA. This routine servicing transfer is not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. Watch for potential borrower distress or workout developments.
